quickProcess.title: Identify a problem
quickProcess.detail: Choose a problem or improvement you can confidently address.

quickProcess.title: Update your fork, then branch
quickProcess.detail: Make sure your fork is up to date, then create a feature branch for the work.

quickProcess.title: Explore the wider effects
quickProcess.detail: Consider alternate solutions, important constraints, and effects on related systems or features.

quickProcess.title: Keep the change small
quickProcess.detail: Make the smallest complete change possible. Avoid scope creep.

quickProcess.title: Explain the PR plainly
quickProcess.detail: Write a concise PR that explains the problem, the change, and what you verified.

workflow.title: Start with the maintainer
workflow.purpose: Your fork can serve your needs. Upstream needs a change it can own.

workflow.title: Find one reviewable idea
workflow.purpose: A contribution should have one reason to exist and a clear boundary.

workflow.title: Make dependencies explicit
workflow.purpose: Trace what the idea actually needs, then prove it from upstream.

workflow.title: Keep history honest
workflow.purpose: Shape history for review while preserving credit and intent.

workflow.title: Prove what you claim
workflow.purpose: A trustworthy handoff distinguishes checked, failed, and untested.

workflow.title: Write the handoff
workflow.purpose: Help another person understand, verify, and maintain the change.

checklist.title: The change fits the project
checklist.detail: Read contribution guidance and link the relevant issue or discussion. Account for the project’s AI contribution policy.

checklist.title: There is one clear, reviewable idea
checklist.detail: Describe the behavior and explain what stays in the fork. Remove unrelated cleanup.

checklist.title: Every prerequisite is accounted for
checklist.detail: Trace code, configuration, assets, migrations, and runtime assumptions. State any required earlier PR.

checklist.title: The contribution works from upstream
checklist.detail: Record the upstream base revision and verify the extracted change in an upstream-based checkout.

checklist.title: History and attribution are honest
checklist.detail: Preserve authorship, license notices, and required sign-offs. Follow the project’s history conventions.

checklist.title: Verification is backed by evidence
checklist.detail: Record actual commands and outcomes. Distinguish failures and untested areas from passing checks.

checklist.title: Tests and documentation match the behavior
checklist.detail: Add a meaningful regression check and update user-facing guidance when relevant.

checklist.title: The maintainer has a clear handoff
checklist.detail: Explain the problem, behavior, dependencies, risks, and limitations using the project’s PR template.
